Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner adopted a flawed standardization—using the first listed IMDb Release Dates entry rather than the earliest release—treating Week-End with Father as a 2011 release instead of its well-documented 1951 release. This misinterpretation led to the incorrect conclusion that Premium (2007) was earlier, contradicting credible sources and the task’s requirement to identify the earliest release.
